login.title: Two Factor Authentication
login.description: Please enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.email-description: We have sent a code to %email%. Please enter it below.
login.email-resent: A new code has been sent.
login.email-failed: The code could not be sent. Please try again later.
login.email-throttled: Please wait %seconds% seconds before requesting a new code.
login.email-code-expired: The code has expired or was entered incorrectly too often. Please request a new code.

account.title: Two Factor Authentication
account.active: Good! Your account is protected with an authenticator app (TOTP).
account.not-active: Your account is currently not protected with Two Factor Authentication!
account.description: Protect your account with two-factor authentication (2FA). When logging in, you then enter a one-time code in addition to your password. You can choose how you receive it: an authenticator app on your smartphone (TOTP, e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or a password manager) generates the code, which may be the more secure option. Alternatively, we send you the code by e-mail, without installing anything.
account.disabled-2fa: Two Factor Authentication was successfully disabled.

setup.title: Set up authenticator app (TOTP)
setup.description: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or a password manager), or enter the key shown below it manually. Then enter the 6-digit code from the app to finish the setup.

disable.title: Disable Two Factor Authentication
disable.description: Please verify that it is you by confirming your password.
disable.submit: Confirm password & disable Two Factor Authentication
disable.forced: This shop requires two-factor authentication. After disabling, you will receive codes by e-mail instead.

error.not-enabled: 2FA is not enabled for this Sales Channel.
error.incorrect-password: The provided password was wrong. Two Factor Authentication is not disabled.
error.incorrect-code: The provided code was not correct.
error.already-enabled: Two Factor Authentication with an app is already active. Disable it first to set up a new app.
error.incorrect-password-setup: The provided password was wrong. The app was not set up.

account.app-forced: This shop requires two-factor authentication. If you disable the app, you will receive codes by e-mail instead.

email.enabled: From now on you will receive a code by e-mail when logging in.
email.active: Your account is protected with codes sent by e-mail.
email.forced: This shop requires two-factor authentication for all customers.
email.app-hint: An authenticator app could be more secure, because it does not depend on your e-mail inbox.
